messages:
maya: dropping the slim-sidebar mock here. Goal: reduce cognitive load for new users, keep 3 primary sections, move misc to a utility rail. Figma link: https://figma.com/file/abc — please focus on routing implications for deep links.

kevin: skimmed it. I like the \"Build / Serve / Monitor\" grouping. Q on permalinks: if we collapse old paths, do we plan server-side 301s or runtime router remap?

ravi: prefer server 301 for SEO and social previews, but runtime remap is safer during rollout. We should do 301s for public pages and keep client-side remaps for internal-only routes.

maya: sounds reasonable. Add to RFC: 301 map + client fallback, plus a deprecation header for older paths.

nina: accessibility concern: when sections collapse/expand, screen reader should announce \"Section X expanded\" via aria-live polite. Also the chevron needs larger touch target on mobile.

design-bot: [contrast-check] sidebar icons contrast 3.6:1 on dark bg; suggested increase stroke to meet 4.5:1 or use slightly lighter fill.

kevin: microcopy thought: change breadcrumb separator from chevron to slash to reduce visual weight. Might improve scan. Also avoid repeating the root label when user drills down (e.g., show \"Models / MyModel\" not \"Console > Models > MyModel\").

ravi: routing edge case: external links that point to deep fragments like /console/models/old-path#/releases — our hash-to-path fallback needs to strip legacy fragments. Proposed helper: 
```
function normalizeIncoming(url){
  // prefer path segments, fallback to hash if path missing
  const path = url.pathname !== '/' ? url.pathname : (new URL(url).hash.replace('#',''))
  return sanitize(path)
}
```

maya: we also need telemetry events for nav clicks and breadcrumb clicks to measure discoverability. Add analytic tags: nav_primary_click, nav_group_expand, breadcrumb_click.

serena: about A/B testing — I'd like to test sticky group headers vs a fixed top-level only. Metric: time-to-first-action and nav abandonment. Small cohort (5%) to start.

nina: keyboard shortcuts proposal: `g then m` to jump to Models (or Build). Make sure focus lands on the first actionable item in that group. Document in keyboard nav doc.

kevin: one more: canonical query param for views, e.g. `/console/builds/123?view=jobs` rather than encoding view in subpath. Easier for sharing deep links across teams.

ravi: agree. Also include redirect table in RFC. Example mapping snippet for infra team: 
```
"/console/old-models/:id" -> "/console/builds/:id?view=meta"  // 301
"/console/models/:id/versions" -> "/console/builds/:id?view=versions" // 301
```

maya: actionables: 1) Kevin to add analytics spec + breadcrumb behaviour (owner: kevin, due: Mon) 2) Nina to add aria-live + keyboard shortcut doc (owner: nina, due: Tue) 3) Ravi to draft redirect map and 301 plan (owner: ravi, due: Tue) 4) Maya to run A/B test plan + cohort config (owner: maya, due: Wed).

serena: tiny UX nit — when a group is collapsed we should still show a tiny indicator count for unread alerts. Keep it subtle.

maya: good call. I'll update figma with contrast changes and the compact counts. Thanks all :sparkles:
